description.en: A quiet hall above the mountain trails, with space for visiting teachers and their students.
description.zh-CN: 山路上方的一座清静会馆，供来访的导师和学生歇脚。

华山大弟子.en: Anubis guards the entrance. He hasn't forgotten the stolen gold.
华山大弟子.zh-CN: 阿努比斯守着入口。他没有忘记被夺走的黄金。

description.en: Took the Iron Sword Token by force.

text.en: You took the gold and threatened everyone who stood in your way. You don't get to walk in here as a guest.
text.zh-CN: 你夺走黄金，还威胁每个挡路的人。别以为到了这里，仍能被当作客人。

text.en: You didn't stop me then. What changed?
text.zh-CN: 上次你没拦住我。现在，有什么不同？

text.en: Horus trusted you. That trust cost him dearly.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯信任过你。为了这份信任，他付出了代价。

text.en: It won't cost anyone else. Put down your weapon.
text.zh-CN: 不能再让别人付出代价。放下武器。

text.en: You can try taking it.
text.zh-CN: 你可以，试着来拿。

text.en: Your whole hall couldn't stop me.
text.zh-CN: 你们整个会馆，也没能拦住我。

text.en: Then stop at the hall. You won't take the Iron Sword tradition with it.
text.zh-CN: 那就到会馆为止。铁剑的传承，不会一起被你夺走。

text.en: More defenders. How considerate.
text.zh-CN: 还有人来守。真是周到。

text.en: Who thinks they can take what's mine?
text.zh-CN: 谁觉得，我的东西也能随便拿走？

text.en: Set? You're standing with me?
text.zh-CN: 赛特？你要站在我这边？

text.en: I'm standing for the order. Don't mistake it for forgiveness.
text.zh-CN: 我是为了传承。别把这当成原谅。

text.en: Then for once, let that be enough.
text.zh-CN: 那这一次，就让它足够吧。

text.en: Still nobody strong enough to keep what I want.
text.zh-CN: 还是没人，能守住我想要的东西。

text.en: This is what you call victory? A hall full of wounded people?
text.zh-CN: 满堂伤者。这就是你所谓的胜利？

text.en: Wait. Spare me, and I'll give you something worth taking.
text.zh-CN: 等等。放过我，我给你一样真正值得拿走的东西。

text.en: Set. At least meet the end without selling everyone else.
text.zh-CN: 赛特。至少在最后，别把所有人都卖了。

text.en: I can take it from you when you're dead.
text.zh-CN: 等你死了，我一样能拿走。

text.en: You can search all you like. You won't find where I hid it.
text.zh-CN: 你尽管找。你不会知道，我把它藏在哪儿。

text.en: You'd bargain with the person who did this?
text.zh-CN: 你要和造成这一切的人讨价还价？

text.en: I spent years chasing the Iron Sword Token. I've finally got it, and now there's no order left to command. I'm not dying for an empty title.
text.zh-CN: 我找了多年，才找到铁剑令牌。现在终于拿到了，却没剩下什么值得号令的人。我不会为一个空名送命。

text.en: The order can keep its name. I'll take its authority. Give me the token.
text.zh-CN: 传承可以留下名字。权力归我。交出令牌。

text.en: That little sword won't make them follow you.
text.zh-CN: 一柄小铁剑，不会让他们追随你。

text.en: The token, or your life.
text.zh-CN: 令牌，或者你的命。

text.en: All right. Take it.
text.zh-CN: 好吧。拿去。

text.en: Break your sword. Then crawl out of my sight.
text.zh-CN: 折断你的剑。然后，从我眼前爬走。

text.en: No. I won't leave myself helpless. I have something better than the token.
text.zh-CN: 不。我不会让自己任人宰割。我还有比令牌更好的东西。

text.en: What could be worth more?
text.zh-CN: 还有什么，比它更值钱？

text.en: Iron Banner Mastery. An old discipline, sealed away for years. I found its manual.
text.zh-CN: 铁旗专精。一门被封存多年的旧学，我找到了它的手册。

text.en: You expect me to trade a victory for a book?
text.zh-CN: 你指望，一本书就能换走我的胜利？

text.en: For a chance to become stronger. Keep your victory. Just let me leave alive.
text.zh-CN: 换一个变强的机会。胜利归你，只让我活着离开。

text.en: The manual. Now.
text.zh-CN: 手册。现在就交出来。

text.en: Here. It's all yours.
text.zh-CN: 在这儿。全归你了。

text.en: Then go. Before I change my mind.
text.zh-CN: 那就走。趁我还没改主意。

text.en: (Set turns away, then lunges.) You first!
text.zh-CN: （赛特转过身，却突然扑来。）你先走！

text.en: You had a way out. Why turn back?
text.zh-CN: 明明有路可走。为什么还要回头？

text.en: (Set's breathing falters.) Because Imhotep was right about one thing.
text.zh-CN: （赛特的呼吸断续起来。）因为有一件事，伊姆霍特普说对了。

text.en: Which thing?
text.zh-CN: 哪件事？

text.en: An order is more than whoever holds its token.
text.zh-CN: 一门传承，不只属于拿着令牌的人。

text.en: Set... You remembered.
text.zh-CN: 赛特……你还记得。

text.en: I wanted to lead it. I didn't want to be the last man who ran from it.
text.zh-CN: 我想领导它。可我不想，成为最后一个逃离它的人。

text.en: (Imhotep gives a faint laugh. His eyes fall still.)
text.zh-CN: （伊姆霍特普轻轻笑了一声，目光随之凝住。）

text.en: (Set opens his hand. Something small and golden moves.) One last trick.
text.zh-CN: （赛特张开手，有个金色的小东西动了动。）最后一招。

text.en: A golden serpent—venom!
text.zh-CN: 金蛇——是毒！

text.en: The venom is out. I still feel weaker.
text.zh-CN: 毒已经排出去了。可这股虚弱，还留着。

text.en: (Set laughs once, then falls silent.)
text.zh-CN: （赛特笑了一声，随后再无声息。）

text.en: A fine prize. And a costly one.
text.zh-CN: 好一份战利品。代价也够高的。
